# Business case outputs - SwarmAI Contact Center (Concierge)

*Generated by `model.py` v1.0.0. Azure list prices from the Azure Retail Prices API (USD, pay-as-you-go, no EA/MCA discount), swedencentral meters; Azure OpenAI at Data Zone (EU) Standard rates; retrieved 2026-11-17. Communications (voice legs, chat, SMS, e-mail) are priced at Azure Communication Services list rates as a proxy for whichever provider carries them; SMS rates from Microsoft Learn. Reference customer: Contoso Home Retail (fictional): 1,500 agents (about 60 % voice capacity / 40 % digital), about 18 M contacts per year, 8 markets. Illustrative and assumption-driven. Every figure flagged validate=true must be replaced with the customer's own data before the case is used for a commitment.*
